modules.title: Systems of Linear Equations: The 5-Second Intersection Trick
modules.problem_statement: If 3x + 2y = 16 and 5x - y = 9, what is the value of x + y?
modules.algebra_trap: Manual elimination/substitution takes 90 seconds with high risk of minus-sign arithmetic errors.
modules.desmos_cheat_code: Type both equations exactly as written. Click the gray dot at the intersection (2, 5). Add 2 + 5 = 7 directly in Desmos in under 5 seconds.
modules.pro_tip: If the SAT asks for x - y or 2x + 3y, never solve by hand—just grab the intersection coordinates and type the target expression into Desmos line 3.
